name: MixMaster VR
summary:
🎧 MixMaster VR
Step into MixMaster VR - the ultimate virtual DJ universe where the party never sleeps. 🔥
From a massive 24/7 free DJ Arena to exclusive ticketed headline events, this is your backstage pass to a whole new way of experiencing music.
  Drift through glowing virtual venues
  Catch your favorite artists spinning live
  Party with music lovers from around the world
  Jump into live chats and hype the crowd together
Whether you're vibing solo or rolling deep with friends, MixMaster VR transforms
